responsibility: This file implements the final RTL-to-assembly emission pass for functions. It scans the post-reload RTL stream, applies last-stage output-time optimizations such as eliding redundant moves or condition-code setups, drives target asm output for instructions, manages source line/discriminator and debug-note emission, coordinates prologue/epilogue and jump-table related output conventions, and performs end-of-function cleanup and bookkeeping such as hard-register usage collection before releasing RTL state.
